title: C sos: wire rate-limit + Schnorr48 verify into SOS rx path and register /sos CoAP resource (spec 18.4 R-12-034..041)
description: Remaining slice of l1qw.25: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/sos_alert.c + sos_resource.c exist but sos_ratelimit_check has zero callers and coap_server.c registers no /sos resource. Wire: rx verify (link-layer Schnorr48 before rebroadcast, silent drop on failure per 18.4) -> rate-limit gate (sos_ratelimit_check/record per source IID; 4.29 Too Many Requests with Retry-After on denial) -> rebroadcast-once. Register /sos GET/POST in coap_server.c. Host tests via the SOS cbor/signature vectors. After the ratelimit vector suite (sibling bead) lands.
